messages:
Lina: Morning — 48h to marketplace launch. Need final owners for: partner preview window, SI dry-run, localized hero copy, and live rollback channel.
Marco: Marketing owns partner preview + press kit. I'll share embargoed Drive link by EOD. Partners must sign off logos by Wed noon.
SI-Lead: We'll run two dry-runs (NA/EU). Plan: 20m handoff, 20m connectivity, 10m failover. Need read-only kube creds + test tenant. Can we get that by Wed 09:00 PT?
DevOps: Yes for creds and test tenant. Also will open maintenance window and create #mp-rollback channel. I'll add Lina, Marco, Ayesha, Legal, SI-Lead.
Ayesha: Product/localization: translating hero and CTA into fr/de/ja/ko. Send final tokenized copy by Tue 22:00 PT or we'll need to ship en-only for some locales.
Legal: Embargo language approved. One request: vector logos + trademark owner contact must be provided with the asset bundle.
Lina: Timeline check: partner preview Thu 14:00 UTC, public Thu 18:00 UTC. Embargo exceptions must be emailed to me + Marco 2h before public.
Marco: I'll distribute an embargo checklist to partners and internal stakeholders. Also will post the draft blog as an embargoed link once logos land.
SI-Lead: Confirmed for dry-run Wed 16:00 PT NA, Wed 22:00 PT EU. Will post invites.
DevOps: #mp-rollback created and pinned runbook. Canary deploy scheduled Wed 03:00 UTC, logs at https://kibana.redwood.example/mp-canary
Lina: Great. Quick pin:
- Press kit & embargoed blog -> Wed 12:00 PT (Marco)
- Logos + trademark contacts -> Wed 12:00 PT (Partners)
- Localized hero copy -> Wed 22:00 PT (Ayesha)
- SI dry-runs -> Wed (SI-Lead)
- Canary deploy & rollback channel -> Wed 03:00 UTC (DevOps)
Lina: Reply with :white_check_mark: when your item is green or DM me blockers. Keeping thread short so partners can skim.
